audit.whatIsWrong: The chart gave Levels 4-5 and First item to 'Skill' and 2+ items to Lucian, while whys[5] says the first-item HP spike lets you walk him down and whys[6] says your HP pool hard-counters him at two items.
audit.why: Packet chart is Lucian for Levels 1 through 6, then Dr. Mundo at First item and 2+ items. That is the standard scaling-tank shape and it explains the 53.83% win rate over 3130 games: Mundo loses the whole lane on paper and wins the game after it.
audit.corrected: Lucian x5, Dr. Mundo at First item and 2+ items — ratings 2/2/2/3/2/6/8.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown numbers, and the first-item flip was not reflected in the chart it belongs to.
audit.why: Relentless Pursuit is 16/15.5/15/14.5/14s, Piercing Light 9/8/7/6/5s, The Culling 110/100/90s. Mundo's Infected Bonesaw is a flat 4s.
audit.corrected: Spikes now name the real cooldowns and the first-item stage is Mundo's on the chart.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two fields tell you to 'Use E Blunt Force Trauma to close' and force out his dash. The decisive Lightslinger interaction is missing entirely, and the range comparison was never stated.
audit.why: Blunt Force Trauma is a targeted slam with an auto-attack reset — Mundo has no dash and cannot close on anything. More importantly, Riot's E text says Lightslinger attacks REDUCE Relentless Pursuit's cooldown, so every double-shot he lands in a trade refunds his escape: waiting for his dash to be down does not work if you keep feeding him attacks. And Infected Bonesaw reaches 975 against Piercing Light's 500 and Ardent Blaze's 900 — Mundo out-ranges Lucian's whole kit with his Q.
audit.corrected: Delete the closing-with-E advice, state that his own attacks refresh the dash, and use the 975 vs 500 range edge as the actual early-game plan.

audit.whatIsWrong: The missing-interactions file flags needs-antiheal and shield-absorbs-burst against Lucian's Lightslinger.
audit.why: Riot's passive text describes bonus damage when Lucian is healed or shielded BY AN ALLY — it grants Lucian no heal and no shield of his own. In a solo top lane there is no ally to trigger it, so those two derived flags misfire here.
audit.corrected: I did not write anti-heal or shield-baiting advice into this matchup.

edits.before: Your sustain starts beating his chip. Track Relentless Pursuit and take the trades it can't answer; you regen, he doesn't.
edits.after: Every Lightslinger shot he lands cuts Relentless Pursuit's 15s cooldown, so trading refunds his escape. Farm; don't feed it.

edits.before: Maximum Dosage makes you nearly unkillable in long fights. The lane flips from 'survive' to 'walk at him' the moment you hit 6.
edits.after: The Culling (110s at rank 1) shreds you if you stand in the cone. Maximum Dosage heals, but not through a full channel yet — walk out.

edits.before: Lucian's Piercing Light (Q) and Ardent Blaze (W) let him poke your green bar from range, and his passive Lightslinger double-shots after every ability shred your health fast. His E Relentless Pursuit dash dodges your Q Infected Bonesaw, so you rarely land the slow. Play for CS under tower and don't chase — he'll kite you into a poke death.
edits.after: Piercing Light (Q) reaches 500 and Ardent Blaze (W) 900, but Infected Bonesaw reaches 975 — your Q out-ranges his entire kit, so poke from the back of the wave. His Lightslinger double-shot after every ability shreds you, and each of those shots cuts Relentless Pursuit's 16s cooldown, so trading refunds his escape. Farm, poke, never chase.

edits.before: Lucian's R The Culling is a channelled hail of bullets that erases you if you stand in it, and he has E dashes to stay at range while it fires. Your R Maximum Dosage heals, but you can't out-heal a full Culling early. Use E Blunt Force Trauma to close and force him to burn Relentless Pursuit, then disengage before he ults.
edits.after: Lucian's R The Culling (110s at rank 1) is a channelled hail of bullets that erases you if you stand in the cone, and Relentless Pursuit keeps him at range while it fires. Maximum Dosage heals percent missing HP but not through a full channel this early. Blunt Force Trauma is a slam, not a dash — you cannot close, so break line of sight behind the wave.

edits.before: Your spike: with Bami's/Sunfire and HP online, Lucian's lane-caliber burst stops threatening your regen. Once you can survive his Q-W-passive combo, you walk him down — a single Q slow plus E lands and he has no follow-up damage to kill a tank. The lane flips here.
edits.after: Your spike: with Bami's/Sunfire and HP online, Lucian's lane-calibre burst stops threatening your regen. One Infected Bonesaw slow on a 4s cooldown plus Blunt Force Trauma's auto-reset is enough, and he has no percent-health damage to answer a tank. The lane flips here and never flips back.

edits.before: Through 4-5 his Relentless Pursuit dodges your Q slow and he pokes freely.
edits.after: Through 4-5 his Lightslinger shots refresh Relentless Pursuit's cooldown.

edits.before: Levels 3-6 stay Lucian's because he out-ranges and out-mobilities you; at 6 his R The Culling can delete you if you stand in the channel. Use E Blunt Force Trauma only to force out his Relentless Pursuit, then back off — you can't out-heal a full ult before items.
edits.after: Levels 3-6 stay Lucian's because he out-mobilities you; at 6 The Culling deletes you if you stand in the cone. Blunt Force Trauma is a slam, not a dash — you cannot close, so poke with your 975-range Q, step out of the channel, and hold Flash as the only exit you own.

edits.before: Kite with E dashes so your Q slow never connects
edits.after: Chip you so Lightslinger refunds his E cooldown

edits.before: - Lucian Relentless Pursuit: matchup-defining — His dash + reset. Engage when it's down. Track it before every engage. - Your engage/committal tool: never waste it on chip damage. - Your ultimate: the win condition — spend it on kill windows, not on waves.
edits.after: - Relentless Pursuit (16s at rank 1): his dash — but Lightslinger attacks REDUCE it, so every trade you take hands the cooldown back. - Piercing Light (9s at rank 1, 5s at rank 5): only 500 range against your 975. - The Culling (110s at rank 1): step out of the cone. - Your R: kill windows, never waves.

edits.before: Concede the first levels — your passive and Doran's Shield regen everything back between waves. Hit Q cleavers for the slow + HP refund and respect Lucian's Relentless Pursuit window completely.
edits.after: Concede the first levels — your passive and Doran's Shield regen it back between waves. Infected Bonesaw reaches 975 against his 500-range Q, so poke from the back of the wave and stop feeding Lightslinger shots that refund his dash.

edits.before: Track Lucian's Relentless Pursuit: His dash + reset. Engage when it's down. When it is down — Cleaver-slow + run him down.
edits.after: Relentless Pursuit (16s at rank 1): his dash — Lightslinger attacks cut its cooldown, so stop trading if you want it down.

notes: Chart set to the packet's scaling-tank shape: Lucian owns Levels 1-6, Mundo takes First item and 2+ items — which is what whys[5] and whys[6] already said and what a 53.83% win rate over 3130 games looks like for a champion who loses lane and wins the game. The packet's own defect note ('chart gives Lucian 5/7 stages') is not an error here; that is the correct shape for Mundo. Killed the 'use E Blunt Force Trauma to close' advice in two places — Mundo has no dash. The load-bearing new fact: Riot's own E text says Lightslinger attacks reduce Relentless Pursuit's cooldown, so the standing advice to 'wait for his dash to be down' fails while you keep trading. The needs-antiheal and shield-absorbs-burst flags on Lightslinger misfire — Riot's text describes being healed or shielded BY AN ALLY, which does not happen in a solo lane, so I wrote neither.
